## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new functionality
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `chore`: maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] Before and after screenshots attached for visual changes
- [ ] Colors stay inside the Solarized palette, or the deviation is justified
- [ ] Tested with ULauncher 5.x and 6.x, or marked N/A with a reason
